name: KRAS4B
description: KRAS isoform 4B with GDP and Mg, generated from scratch (2026-10-10) so the structures match the isoform of both the HA1E GOF DMS screen and the AlphaMissense scores (afm_KRAS4B_predictions.tsv). Variants = (1) a draw blind to both the assay and AM: 5 random substitutions at each of the 187 assayed positions (analyses/continuous/kras4b_coverage/make_batch.py, seed per position), plus (2) the 60 hotspot variants of the previous batch (the former 4A cohort + G151M, H166W, K178M, M188I), forced in via 'include'. Only stratum (1) is a sample of the screen; analyses/continuous/kras4b_coverage/results/batch_strata.csv says which is which. Job names stay KRAS_* because the DRIFT runtime's bare [A-Z]\d+[A-Z] parser would read a KRAS4B_ prefix as the variant S4B; the archive name and the 188-aa sequence distinguish this batch from the 4A one, so keep its outputs in a separate directory.

chains.note: Isoform 4B (UniProt P01116-2 / ENST00000311936), 188 aa. Literal so the batch is reproducible without a UniProt round trip; bare P01116 is 4A.
